candidates.title: Management analysis tools
candidates.statement: The system shall provide tools for library administrators, managers, and staff to analyze operations, manage collections, and make data-driven decisions.
candidates.source_quote: provides the tools needed for library administrators, managers, and staff to analyze operations, manage collections, and make data-driven decisions.

candidates.title: Centralized multi-location operations
candidates.statement: The system shall consolidate Management Processes at a central location and accept input from and provide services to multiple library locations.
candidates.source_quote: The Management Processes are consolidated at a central location and accept input from and provide services to multiple library locations.

candidates.title: Integration with ILS modules
candidates.statement: The system shall rely on and integrate with the data structures and functionality of the broader ILS, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.
candidates.source_quote: They rely on the data structures and functionality of the broader ILS, including Acquisitions and Cataloging modules.

candidates.title: Collection usage analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide analysis capabilities for the library collection and its use by patrons.
candidates.source_quote: Analyzing the Library collection and its use by patrons.

candidates.title: Branch capacity and distribution analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide analysis capabilities for branch capacity and optimal distribution of the collection.
candidates.source_quote: Analyzing branch capacity and optimal distribution of the collection.

candidates.title: Patron demographics analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide analysis capabilities for the demographics and interests of patrons.
candidates.source_quote: Analyzing the demographics and interests of patrons.

candidates.title: Staff productivity and workflow analysis
candidates.statement: The system shall provide analysis capabilities for staff productivity and workflow.
candidates.source_quote: Analyzing staff productivity and workflow.

candidates.title: Financial transaction tracking
candidates.statement: The system shall track and verify financial transactions related to library operations.
candidates.source_quote: Tracking and verifying financial transactions.

candidates.title: Consortium-scale capacity support
candidates.statement: The system shall support a library consortium scale of at least 286 locations, 17 million annual circulations, and purchasing/processing over 900,000 items per year.
candidates.source_quote: support a library consortium with 286 locations, 17 million annual circulations, and purchasing/processing over 900,000 items per year.

candidates.title: Reports and searches during open hours
candidates.statement: The system shall allow searches and reports to be processed during open hours without disrupting other system functions.
candidates.source_quote: highly desirable that searches and reports can be processed during open hours without disrupting other system functions.

candidates.title: Server OS support
candidates.statement: The system shall operate on a Linux or Solaris server environment.
candidates.source_quote: The system must operate on a Linux or Solaris server environment.

candidates.title: Client access options
candidates.statement: The system shall be accessible through a web browser or a Windows-compatible client.
candidates.source_quote: The system must be accessible through a web browser or a Windows-compatible client.

candidates.title: Supported web browsers
candidates.statement: If web-browser based, the system shall be accessible through Microsoft Internet Explorer (version 6.0 and later) and Mozilla Firefox (version 2.0 and later).
candidates.source_quote: accessible through Microsoft Internet Explorer (version 6.0 and later) and Mozilla Firefox (version 2.0 and later).

candidates.title: Assistive technology accessibility
candidates.statement: The system shall be accessible with screen-reading software, screen-magnification software, and other assistive technology programs.
candidates.source_quote: accessible with screen-reading software, screen-magnification software, and other assistive technology programs

candidates.title: Relational database backend
candidates.statement: The system shall use a fully relational database back-end.
candidates.source_quote: The system must use a fully relational database back-end.

candidates.title: Standards-compliant HTML output
candidates.statement: The system shall produce standards-compliant HTML output for web-based components.
candidates.source_quote: The system must produce standards-compliant HTML output for web-based components.

candidates.title: Development and training environment
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a development and training environment with the ability to migrate configurations to a production environment.
candidates.source_quote: provide a development and training environment with the ability to migrate configurations to a production environment.

candidates.title: Role-based access control
candidates.statement: The system shall control user rights and privileges through security groups and/or roles that allow access control for individuals, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups.
candidates.source_quote: User rights and privileges will be controlled through security groups and or "roles" that allow access control for individuals, workgroups, and arbitrary staff groups.

candidates.title: Non-constraint of OPAC
candidates.statement: The system shall not constrain functionality or features of the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) module.
candidates.source_quote: These requirements must not constrain functionality or features of the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC) module.

candidates.title: Data specifications for records
candidates.statement: The developer shall provide complete data specifications for authority records, bibliographic records, order records, item records, hold/request records, and other records maintained or accessed by the Management Processes.
candidates.source_quote: The developer must provide complete data specifications for authority records, bibliographic records, order records, item records, hold/request records, and other records maintained or accessed by the Management Processes.

candidates.title: High-level process descriptions
candidates.statement: The developer shall provide a thorough high-level description of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation of bibliographic records against internal and external authority sources, and standard reports.
candidates.source_quote: provide a thorough high-level description of major processes, including bibliographic record import and export, validation of bibliographic records against internal and external authority sources, and standard reports.

candidates.title: Online hierarchical HTML help
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an online, hierarchical, and cross-linked help system in HTML that describes and illustrates all system functions.
candidates.source_quote: The system must provide an online, hierarchical, and cross-linked help system in HTML that describes and illustrates all system functions.

candidates.title: Error reporting and admin feedback
candidates.statement: The system shall provide thorough high-level error reporting and feedback, and shall allow low-level query-specific feedback for Local and Global System Administrators from the front-end interface.
candidates.source_quote: provide thorough high-level error reporting and feedback, and shall allow low-level query-specific feedback for Local and Global System Administrators from the front-end interface.

candidates.title: OPAC patron access
candidates.statement: The system shall support patron interaction with library resources through the Online Public Access Catalog (OPAC).
candidates.source_quote: Patrons may interact with the system through the OPAC.

candidates.title: Local admin configuration and reporting
candidates.statement: The system shall allow Local System Administrators to configure local settings and run system reports.
candidates.source_quote: Local System Administrators: ... They can configure local settings and run system reports.

candidates.title: Reports for managers' planning
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports suitable for planning and evaluation to Library Managers.
candidates.source_quote: Library Managers: ... They use reports for planning and evaluation.

candidates.title: Aggregated high-level reports
candidates.statement: The system shall produce aggregated, high-level reports suitable for strategic planning and board presentations for Library Administrators.
candidates.source_quote: They require aggregated, high-level reports for strategic planning and board presentations.

candidates.title: Global admin system management and reporting
candidates.statement: The system shall provide Global System Administrators with capabilities to implement software changes and configurations and to generate statistical reports for the entire system/consortium.
candidates.source_quote: Global System Administrator: ... implementing software changes and configurations, and generating statistical reports for the entire system.

candidates.title: Operate within enterprise library automation
candidates.statement: The Management Processes component shall operate as part of a larger enterprise-level Library Automation System and interoperate with other modules.
candidates.source_quote: This component operates as part of a larger enterprise-level Library Automation System.
